The indoor pool environment should keep consistent landmarks and materials across the transition, including the pool lanes, deck, windows, rock feature, exhibit panels, irregular floor-material boundary, and restrained high-contrast accent on a real object.

Camera movement through the pool deck must remain plausible for first-person navigation, with stable scale, support, perspective changes, pool/deck boundaries, and no clipping through barriers, signs, water, or non-navigation space.

The primary axis is transition correctness for an exploratory_transition with explicit navigation controls W, W+D, then right; evaluation must verify forward movement, diagonal/rightward drift, and a rightward view rotation through the indoor pool while respecting navigable deck space.
